- [`d4h_aggregate`](data4health-reference/d4h_aggregate.Rd.qmd): The 'd4h_aggregate()' function aggregates health data
 by specified spatial and temporal columns.

- [`d4h_clean`](data4health-reference/d4h_clean.Rd.qmd): 'd4h_clean()' performs basic data
 cleaning operations on health-related datasets.

- [`d4h_example`](data4health-reference/d4h_example.Rd.qmd): The 'data4health' package includes some example files in
 its  inst/extdata  directory.

- [`d4h_filter`](data4health-reference/d4h_filter.Rd.qmd): The 'data4health' package provides a function for filtering
 dataframes.

- [`d4h_load`](data4health-reference/d4h_load.Rd.qmd): The 'd4h_load()' function loads files into the R environment.

- [`d4h_save`](data4health-reference/d4h_save.Rd.qmd): The 'd4h_save()' function saves dataframes to your local
 disk.

- [`d4h_ui`](data4health-reference/d4h_ui.Rd.qmd): The 'd4h_ui()' function opens the data4health user interface
 in a web browser.

- [`data4health-package`](data4health-reference/data4health-package.Rd.qmd): Provides a streamlined workflow for cleaning, transforming, filtering, aggregating, and exporting epidemiological line list data.

- [`example_dataset`](data4health-reference/example_dataset.Rd.qmd): A simulated dataset of 500 dengue notification records including
 demographic, geographic, clinical, and laboratory information.
